description: Regex patterns to detect spam/injection prompts. Each pattern has a description and can be enabled/disabled.

patterns.name: xml_conversation_tag
patterns.description: Detects XML <Conversation> tags used by bots

patterns.name: begin_response_instruction
patterns.regex: Begin your response to the most recent message
patterns.description: Detects instruction looking like prompt injections

patterns.name: combined_conversation_injection
patterns.description: Combined pattern detecting the full injection structure observed in spam

notes: To add a pattern: add an object with name, regex, flags, description, enabled
Available flags: IGNORECASE, MULTILINE, DOTALL, ASCII, VERBOSE
Set enabled: false to temporarily disable a pattern without removing it
